Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks for the detail — super helpful. High level answers below; Marissa / Marcus added notes for technical/contract specifics.

1) Pricing / unit economics (ballpark illustrative):
- Reserved Dedicated Capacity (preferred for predictable unit cost): $600–$900 per 1M tokens (with typical 12–24mo commit and autoscale policies).
- Private/VPC (customer-managed VPC, Redwood control plane): $400–$1,000 per 1M tokens depending on environment count + whether you take Priority support.
- On-prem (air-gapped): custom pricing — typically +15–25% uplift for on-prem packaging, integration, and licensing.

Factors that move the needle downward:
- Higher commit term and volume discounts (example: 12mo commit reduces $/1M by ~15%; 24mo by ~25%).
- Aggressive quantization / int8 / int4 options and model selection.
- Caching and prefix reuse across requests.

2) Licensing model and environment billing:
- High-level: annual platform fee + per-environment fee (prod, staging, DR) + usage unit (tokens) for inference.
- Non-prod discount: typically 50% off the per-environment fee for staging/testing environments (not for production).
- VPC vs on-prem: VPC (customer VPC + Redwood control plane) follows the standard per-environment + usage model; fully on-prem gets a larger platform fee and per-environment licensor due to integration/support overhead.

3) Support tiers / compliance:
- Standard: business hours, email + ticketing, SLA response 8–16 business hours.
- Priority: 24x7 coverage, 4-hour incident response, proactive runbooks.
- Enterprise: named TAM, quarterly reviews, custom SLA (often required for finance).
- SOC2: yes, we can provide SOC2 Type II report and encryption-at-rest details. See attached SLA summary.

4) Environment count / sizing ask:
- For pricing worksheet, please confirm the intended environment set (examples below):
  a) Pilot: 1 prod, 1 staging — 2 environments
  b) Full roll-out: 1 prod, 2 staging (canary + integration), 1 DR — 4 environments
- Also share basic perf targets (tokens/sec) or peak concurrency so Marcus can size instance counts.

Next steps:
- If you confirm volumes and desired environments, we’ll produce a refined worksheet with line items (platform fee, env fees, support tier, estimated compute cost and $/1M token result).
- We’ll include discount tiers for commit length.

Sending revised worksheet and SLA summary as attachments now.

Thanks,
Ben
